# Invented learning gardens review protocol

## Research question

## Scope and authorization

## Inclusion criteria
Include every corpus record supplied in input.json, together with its supplied claim, source text, citation identity, role, and synthesis wording. No date, language, population, or method restrictions beyond membership in this supplied fixture apply.

## Exclusion criteria
Exclude records and assertions not supplied in the fixture. Do not supplement the fixture with real publications or inferred bibliographic identifiers.

Both source texts are present locally. No external full text or PDF was sought, and no external publication identity or retrieval status is asserted. There are no missing supplied sources. Retrieval commentary is kept here to preserve synthesis.md exactly.
